title: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance…
content: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 to turn a single image/concept into a storyboard and then generate the video in Seedance.
tips: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 to turn a single image/concept into a storyboard and then generate the video in Seedance.

es.content: Utiliza un flujo de trabajo de Imagen/Concepto → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 para convertir una sola imagen/concepto en un storyboard y luego generar el video en Seedance.

fr.content: Utilisez un flux de travail Image/Concept → GPT personnalisé → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 pour transformer une seule image/concept en storyboard, puis générez la vidéo dans Seedance.

ja.content: 画像/コンセプト → カスタムGPT → 画像からストーリーボードへ → Seedance 2.0 のワークフローを使用して、単一の画像/コンセプトをストーリーボードに変換し、その後Seedanceでビデオを生成します。

ko.content: 이미지/컨셉 → Custom GPT → 이미지-스토리보드 → Seedance 2.0의 워크플로우를 사용하여 단일 이미지/컨셉을 스토리보드로 변환한 후 Seedance에서 비디오를 생성하세요.

pt.content: Use um fluxo de trabalho de Imagem/Conceito → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 para transformar uma única imagem/conceito em um storyboard e, em seguida, gerar o vídeo no Seedance.

zh.content: 使用图像/概念 → 自定义GPT → 图像到故事板 → Seedance 2.0 的工作流程，将单个图像/概念转化为故事板，然后在Seedance中生成视频。
